verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly support tackling Linear/Jira tickets directly, and its MCP extensibility framework is documented as connecting to "issue trackers" broadly, giving a plausible path to ClickUp/Monday.com. However, only Linear and Jira are named explicitly; no first-party integration or docs specifically mention ClickUp or Monday.com. Missing for 10: explicit ClickUp/Monday.com integration docs, evidence of two-way ticket management (not just task ingestion), and independent confirmation these connections work in practice.
